items.who: Margate House Films · Dir. Jake Allyn
items.summary: The production has committed one-third of the film’s profits to Brooke’s House, the Hagerstown, Maryland recovery center whose founding inspired the film. The pledge needs a follow-up after release: whether profits arrived, and how much reached Brooke’s House.
items.followUp: Pledge of profits · follow up after release

items.who: Art director Ajayan Chalissery · Dir. Chidambaram
items.summary: After filming wrapped, residents of Kunduvadi asked the crew to leave a bus stop built as a set. Nearly a year later, the shelter remains in daily use by residents and schoolchildren across the tribal hamlet’s seven settlements.

related.label: Related case: Field of Dreams · The Accidental Asset

items.who: HBO production · Town of High River
items.summary: The production paid the town $100,000 for a youth legacy project: 80 percent for a bike park and pump track, and 20 percent for the Spitzee School playground. It separately paid $15,000 for three removed trees. Current status of the park still needs confirmation.
items.followUp: Newly surfaced older report · confirm whether the pump track was built and is open
